dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures are visible in the upper-mid region, characterized by irregular, jagged high-contrast perimeters where dark exterior pixels transition sharply to a light grey/white rim surrounding a dark core. A fourth 'C' shaped structure is visible in the lower-central section with a less defined, more diffused gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily concentrated along the dorsal ridge above the macro-annuli. These clusters are small, asymmetrical, and lack internal gradients or cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. The distance between the two lateral-most centroids is approximately 1.5 times the distance between the two dorsal-most centroids, creating an elongated geometric relationship along the lateral-ventral axis.
